name: claude-mods
description: Personal Claude Code plugin set: a model router that picks a model and effort per prompt, a task stopwatch, and a mirror of Cursor's Thermos review plugin. install.sh installs the whole set.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Classifies each prompt as simple, medium or complex and routes the turn to a cheaper or stronger model and effort.

plugins.name: task-timer
plugins.description: Stopwatch for turns and named tasks: live elapsed time above the prompt and a /timer pane with per-turn duration, tools, model and tokens.

plugins.name: thermos
plugins.description: Mirror of Cursor's Thermos plugin for Claude Code: thermo-nuclear branch review skills and subagents, with model invocation enabled.
